key.name: hide-shortcut
key.summary: Shortcut to conceal the active window
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to conceal the focused window from Alt+Tab and Overview. Default: Ctrl+Alt+J

key.name: restore-shortcut
key.summary: Shortcut to open the restore menu
key.description: Opens the panel menu to release concealed windows. Default: Ctrl+Alt+K

key.name: panic-shortcut
key.summary: Shortcut for Panic Mode (conceal all active windows)
key.description: Conceals all visible windows on the screen instantly. Default: Ctrl+Alt+Escape
